title: Neptune Apex Reading Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — via MQTT and controller APIs (Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neptune:apex
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(probe_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Neptune Apex reading events land each day and how many distinct probe values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Neptune Apex reading records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct probe values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It treats how much Neptune Apex reading activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
